preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100000 for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each string s in the test cases has a length between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
Each string s in the test cases consists only of lowercase letters (a-z).

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases T.
Each output line contains a single integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) == sum(s.count(s[j:k]) for j in range(len(s)) for k in range(j+1, len(s)+1)) for i, s in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is the self-similarity of the corresponding input string s, calculated as the sum of the number of occurrences of all nonempty substrings p in s.
